caption:
Every morning on our expeditions begins at a table like this.

Rice and beans, fried plantain, eggs, and black coffee before the shoes go on. Every breakfast is included on the route, because running 25 kilometres with 2,350 metres of descent down the Savegre valley requires honest fuel.

On Day 4, you leave Providencia for the Queen Stage. Between the 1,910-metre high point and the river below, local families open their kitchen doors to hand runners fruit and agua dulce. We keep groups to 6 to 8 athletes so there is always a seat at the table.

The Trail Running Expedition. Departures: 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
